raw_signal_observation: Note.vue computes title changes as unsaved in isContentChanged(), but the change watcher that sets unsavedChanges and window.onbeforeunload is triggered only by ToastEditor @change. The title input has v-model.trim with no corresponding change watcher.
material_claim: A title-only edit can remain unprotected by beforeunload and therefore may be lost on browser/tab unload without the warning used for content edits.
neta_next_move: Run a component/integration test that edits only the title, leaves editor content unchanged, and checks unsavedChanges plus window.onbeforeunload before navigation/unload.
reversal_condition: If another mounted watcher or router guard activates unload protection for title-only edits, the mechanism is refuted.
baseline_decision: BUILD: watch newTitle and call the same unsaved-change handler / beforeunload protection used for editor content.

evidence: Open bug #281 reports an unsaved-edit navigation path where returning with browser Back clears the note title and prevents saving; the issue explicitly links the failure to unsaved draft/navigation state.
No independent report found that isolates title-only edit plus browser/tab unload, so the exact beforeunload mechanism remains unconfirmed.
adjudication.decision_delta: Neta chose an integrated discriminator instead of immediately adding a watcher. Independent evidence supports the broader unsaved-title/navigation failure family but does not prove the exact proposed fix, so the restraint survives only partially.
adjudication.lesson: A neighboring real bug can support a failure family without licensing mechanism-level closure. Keep the title-only unload claim open until reproduced.
